title: Realistic Vista
description: Realistic water and lava shading for Iris/OptiFine — real depth-based water color and cracked, glowing lava crust.
body:
# RealisticVista

A forward-shaded Iris/OptiFine shaderpack focused on making **water and lava feel physically grounded** rather than just glossy overlays — real depth-based water coloring, layered ripple detail, and bump-mapped, vein-cracked lava crust.

## ✨ Features

**Water**
- Real depth-based shading — water actually darkens with true column depth (using the scene's depth buffer), giving a natural shoreline-to-deep gradient instead of a flat tint
- Dual-scale ripple normals: broad rolling waves + fine micro-ripple detail up close
- Dual-lobe specular (sharp sun glint + soft broad highlight) plus a drifting sparkle layer
- Smooth, organic whitecap foam on wave crests and along shorelines — no blocky noise grid
- Sky/fog reflection that shifts naturally with time of day and weather

**Lava**
- Bump-mapped crust — cracks and ridges actually catch light instead of reading as a flat glow
- Thin glowing veins tracing crack boundaries instead of soft color bands
- Randomized bubble-pop hotspots simulating gas venting through the crust
- Subtle obsidian-glass specular highlight on cooled crust areas

## ⚙️ Compatibility
Written in the standard OptiFine-compatible shader format (GLSL 120, legacy `DRAWBUFFERS`) — no version-locked features, so it should run wherever **Iris** or **OptiFine** is supported (currently Minecraft 1.16.5 through the latest 1.21.x).

## 🎛️ Configurable Options
Tweak wave height, foam intensity, water depth-fade distance, lava glow strength, specular strength, bloom, fog density, and more from the in-game shader options screen.
